I have tingling and numbness in my feet all the time.
Well, I am not doing my job the way I used to. I can't get it up, doc.
I tend to sweat and notice my heart racing occasionally.
I suffered a heart attack last year.
I have high cholesterol. It was diagnosed 2 years ago.
My father passed away from a stroke at 60.

opening.text: I'm here for a diabetes checkup. I've been having some trouble lately; I have tingling and numbness in my feet all the time, and I can't get it up the way I used to. I also tend to sweat and notice my heart racing occasionally. I had a heart attack last year, and I've had high cholesterol for two years. My father passed away from a stroke at 60.
